description: Single storey rear extension, replacement railing at first floor rear.
decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Existing and Proposed Site and Location Plan 5966/04Existing Ground Floor Plan 5966/05Existing First Floor Plan 5966/06Existing Front Elevation 5966/09Existing Side Elevation 5966/10Existing Rear Elevation 5966/11Existing Section A 5966/12Proposed Ground Floor Plan 5966/15 AProposed First Floor Plan 5966/16 AProposed Front Elevation 5966/20 AProposed Side Elevation 5966/21 AProposed Rear Elevation 5966/22 AProposed Section A 5966/23 AProposed Section B 5966/24 AProposed SUDS Plan 5966/17 ASuDS ProformaReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing building or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no balustrades, railings, screens, fences or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof of the extension(s), other than the replacement enclosure hereby approved in the position shown on the approved plans. The approved enclosure shall not be increased in height, altered in form, or extended without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.The roof of the extension(s) shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden, terrace, sitting out area or for any other recreational purpose. Access to the roof shall be limited to purposes of maintenance, repair, inspection of the property, or means of emergency escape only.Reason: To safeguard the privacy and amenities of the occupiers of adjoining residential properties.
